rules: A line ordered in rides the next run whose order cutoff has not passed. Cutoff = cutoff_business_days_before business days before the run, at cutoff_time.
Goods reach Sechelt the evening of the run and are ready ready_business_days_after_run business days later (the next business morning). Powell River adds its order_in_extra_business_days.
An order is order_in if ANY line is order_in: the whole order is ready together.
All lines on the shelf: ready the same business day if paid before store.same_day_cutoff, else the next business morning.
A holiday closes the store and cancels a run falling on it (the order moves to the next run), unless the holiday row says store_open or truck_runs true.
Business days are store.business_days minus holidays. Order cutoffs use the same calendar.
